t: The Twilight Giant Pathway has traditional warrior abilities, both offensive and defensive. They possess extreme strength, can easily master all weapons, physically resist supernatural powers, conjure powerful Dawn light-based weapons and armour, harm evil spirits, take damage for others, and enter an almost unbreakable defensive stance.

At High-Sequences, they can mix powerful concoctions for enhancements, and healing, or apply various effects, conceal their intentions, physically become mercurial liquefaction, identify weaknesses in others, and bend light to hide their presence.

Beyonders of this pathway become drastically taller from Sequence 6, and this trait can be passed on to their descendants. That's why the descendants of Giants are taller than average humans. Such a trait is a stereotype amongst the Standard Pathways. Having a giant's bloodline doesn't necessarily mean that they have giant blood flowing in them. Instead, it referred to a physical characteristic that was inherited by descendants thanks to the ancestral consumption of the pathway's potion. Tall stature is one of its manifestations.
The Above the Sequence of the Twilight Giant Pathway is the Eternal Darkness, and the corresponding Sefirah is the River of Eternal Darkness.
